You control a Saproling.

222-527-5434-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.

1164-3002-4740-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-3002-4740-6900.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Rest in Peace, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Gwenom.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-3002-4740-6900.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

1263-4871-5670-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-5931.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Funeral Room and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1456-5078-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:

997-4694-5805-7306.description:

When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

2738-3967-4314-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3259-3480-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

3259-3480-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2511-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:

You control another nonland creature.
2511-6887-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

67-1676-2842-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-2842-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it and Boss's Chauffeur trigger, causing you to mill three cards and put a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen.
When the Citizen dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it.
When Seedship Broodtender dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender ability, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
67-1676-2842-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

586-3771-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-6458.easyPrerequisites:

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1367-1618-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1367-1618-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Nexus of Fate and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1367-1618-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Nexus of Fate and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Nexus of Fate and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Nexus of Fate and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1367-1618-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1437-6018.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Quarry Hauler spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap Staff of Domination using its other abilities if it does not have summoning sickness.

Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life.

Holding priority, repeat.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
